purpose: Teach: 語句/教え子/腑/灌/學/実技/参謀/交錯

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約書の難解な語句を弁護士に確認させろ
lines.en: Have our legal team verify the complex contractual language in the agreement.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clipped pacing on each instruction. No softness—this is a directive, not a question. Lean forward slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの教え子の方々を取引先にご紹介します
lines.en: Understood. I'll introduce you to some of my father's former students who could serve as contacts.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Rapid acknowledgment at the start. Careful enunciation—showing he's taken the instruction seriously. Level eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の不満が腑に落ちる説明をしろ
lines.en: Make sure the staff understands the reasoning behind our decisions. They need it to make sense to them.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Slight emphasis on 'understands'—pressing the importance of clarity. Steady pace, deliberate. The tone of someone who knows confusion breeds resentment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元寺院の灌仏会に寄付します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange a donation to the local temple's Buddha-bathing ceremony.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Quick, confident delivery—he's already mentally moving to implementation. Small breath after 'Understood,' then action-ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業時の社名の旧字体學を社史に残せ
lines.en: Make sure the company history preserves the original kanji form of our founding name.
lines.style: Formal, precise. Slight weight on 'original'—this matters historically. Slower pace than the others, almost ceremonial. The voice of someone protecting institutional memory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の実技研修を毎月開催します
lines.en: Understood. I'll schedule monthly skills training sessions for the team.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation. Already thinking ahead to logistics—you can hear the mental checklist forming. Professional, eager to execute. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、経営戦略の参謀役を顧問に任せろ
lines.en: Assign the role of strategic advisor to an external consultant. We need that perspective.
lines.style: Commanding but reasoned. Slight pause before 'external'—showing the thought behind the decision. Authoritative without harshness. The tone of leadership that explains as it directs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業領域が交錯する案件は事前協議します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate with the other departments before moving forward on any cross-functional projects.
lines.style: Final confirmation—slightly more weight than the others, signaling closure. Measured, professional. A promise being made. Quiet steadiness in the delivery.
